description: Find Medicare and Medicaid certified nursing homes near a ZIP code (default 10 miles) or latitude and longitude, or in a city, county or state, or by name, ranked by CMS overall star rating (or inspection, staffing, quality, nurse hours, distance or name). Each result has the four star ratings, beds, ownership, nurse hours per resident per day, staff turnover, fines, the abuse icon, Special Focus Facility status and the ccn for nursing_home_ratings.

exclude_abuse_icon.description: Leave out facilities CMS flags with the abuse icon.

exclude_special_focus.description: Leave out Special Focus Facilities and candidates.

limit.description: How many facilities to return, 1 to 50. Default 15.

min_overall_rating.description: Only facilities with at least this many overall stars.

radius_miles.description: Radius around the ZIP or point, 1 to 50 miles. Default 10.

sort.description: Sort order. Default overall (ties by inspections, staffing, then distance).

state.description: State as a two-letter code (VT) or name (Vermont).

name: nursing_home_search
title: Find and rank nursing homes
